caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a hand tool with a handle and a metal component. The main part of the object is made of wood with visible grain patterns and a rich brown color, shaped with ergonomic curves for gripping. Attached to one end is a lighter brown, smoothly contoured handle, featuring detailed lines that suggest wood grain texture and two circular features at either end. Where the handle meets the body, there is a round pivot point, possibly signifying movement or rotation. On the opposite, broader end of the wooden body, there is a flat, rectangular metallic plate with four round fasteners, colored yellowish gold. The background is a uniform light beige color, and the drawing appears on slightly textured paper. The artist’s signature, "Richard Lilja...," is faintly visible in the lower right corner.
title: Watchman's Rattle
